0022600112.text: The Utah Jazz (1-1, 1-0 at home, 8th in the West and 1 game back in the Northwest) host the Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, 1st in the West and 1st in the Pacific) in the Jazz's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah coming off a win and Los Angeles riding a two-game winning streak. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost 0-4 to the Lakers in the 2025-26 season series, including a 131-107 loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
